t: Oranjehaven was a society for Dutch refugees who wanted to join the Allied forces during the Second World War. It was founded by Queen Wilhelmina of the Netherlands, who reigned from 1890 until 1948, nearly fifty-eight years, the longest of any Dutch monarch. Her reign took in both world wars. The society gave men who had fled the occupied Netherlands a way to take part in the fight. Little remains to tell you more, so take a moment to think about those who passed through.
